title: Stable softmax
prompt: Return row-wise softmax for a 2D array. Example: [1000,1000] becomes [0.5,0.5].
tests:
with np.errstate(over='raise'):
    assert np.allclose(softmax([[1000,1000]]),[[0.5,0.5]]), 'Avoid overflow for large scores'
a=np.array([[1,2,3],[-2,0,1]])
assert np.allclose(softmax(a).sum(axis=1),1), 'Each row must sum to one'
assert np.allclose(softmax(a),softmax(a+100)), 'Adding a row-wide constant must not change probabilities'
hint: Keep dimensions while taking max and sum.

title: Pairwise AUC
prompt: Return positive-negative pairwise ranking accuracy with half credit for ties. Return None if either class is absent. Example: labels [1,1,0,0], scores [0.8,0.6,0.2,0.6] gives 0.875.
tests:
assert auc([1,1,0,0],[0.8,0.6,0.2,0.6])==0.875, 'Count three wins and one tie'
assert auc([1,0],[0.1,0.9])==0, 'Reversed ranking gives zero'
assert auc([1,0],[0.5,0.5])==0.5, 'Ties get half credit'
assert auc([1,1],[0.2,0.3]) is None, 'AUC requires both classes'
hint: Normalise by number of positive-negative pairs.
